layer1.name: Balsamiq
layer1.one_liner: Wireframing software that deliberately looks hand-drawn.
layer1.description: A mockup tool whose sketchy visual style keeps reviewers arguing about structure rather than pixels. Built nights and weekends by one person before he quit his job, sold as a desktop licence.
layer1.outcome_note: Reached $100k revenue within five months and over $2M within two years, with no outside funding. Reported around $6.58M revenue in 2024. The founder has published company numbers throughout.
